prd_sections.title: Agent Architecture
prd_sections.summary: Specifies agent discovery, aliasing, and runtime model with filesystem authority.

prd_sections.title: Table Details
prd_sections.summary: Covers namespace runtime tables including lupo_agent_faucets and lupo_agent_tool_calls.

prd_sections.title: Doctrine and Authority Rules
prd_sections.summary: Enforces strict agent-vs-actor separation, metadata schema discipline, and timestamp authority.

prd_sections.title: Constitutional Memory Addendum
prd_sections.summary: Applies context-typed, status-aware, directional memory edge requirements.

prd_rules.summary: Agent definitions are discovered from lupo-agents directories as primary authority, not database rows.
Agents are templates while actors are runtime entities; identity layers must not be conflated.
Agent metadata_json and related structures must follow canonical schema requirements.
Agent tool-call events must be attributable, retained, and reviewable in runtime tables.
Memory edges with status needs_review require explicit review_reason.

definitions.meaning: Filesystem-based loading and validation of agent definitions via AgentDiscovery.
Execution surface mapping through lupo_agent_faucets for controlled agent access.
Immutable agent definition under lupo-agents used to instantiate runtime behavior.
Contextual execution identity tracked in actor-oriented runtime models.
Auditable invocation record in lupo_agent_tool_calls for governance and diagnostics.
